files.neg_rate_department.csv: negative rate by department (primary set, Noosa excluded)
files.neg_rate_dealer.csv: negative rate by dealer, raw and department-adjusted (observed/expected at group department rates); rank 1 = worst
files.neg_rate_dealer_dept.csv: dealer x department negative rate, all 24 dealers incl. Noosa and n<30 cells (value-model input; filter n>=30, drop QLD05)
files.series_month_department.csv: monthly negative rate by department and All (Noosa excluded)
files.series_month_dealer.csv: monthly negative rate and 5-point mean rating by dealer (all dealers)
files.change_h1_h2_dealer_dept.csv: H1 (Oct-Mar) vs H2 (Apr-Sep) within dealer x department: Wilson CIs, Newcombe CI for the difference, pooled z-test, BH q over tested cells (n>=30 both halves), monthly Cochran-Armitage trend, contribution to the mix-adjusted group change (pp)
files.change_h1_h2_summary.csv: H1 vs H2 raw and mix-adjusted change: group (fixed dealer x dept mix), department (fixed dealer mix), state/region, dealer (fixed dept mix; BH q across dealers)
files.sensitivity.csv: each headline under each sensitivity scenario, with survives yes/NO
files.text_coverage_dealer.csv: text and model-eligible coverage by dealer; negative vs non-negative comment rates (individual responses only)
files.text_coverage_band.csv: comment and model-eligible share by rating band and department (Noosa excluded)
files.response_coverage_dealer_dept.csv: rated responses per 1,000 sales/service jobs/parts transactions by dealer x department and half (coverage indicator only)
